test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All keys are locks.

All locks are handles.

**Conclusions:**

I. All locks are keys.

II. All handles are keys.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Given:**

**Statements:**

All keys are locks.

All locks are handles.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad52bbdfd54ff85890181546899585dd59df9dfbce35b944f82d1ade8e5d928c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All locks are keys. → **False **(It is given that all keys are locks. So, all lock can never be keys.)

II. All handles are keys → **False **(It is given that all keys are lock and all locks are handles. So, all handles can never be keys.)

So,** Neither Conclusion I Nor Conclusion II** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***
